summary: Romantic media web page with hero background image, autoplaying looping background music, and image/video memory grids featuring 3D flip/rotate animations with romantic message reveals plus simple content management controls.
architectural_notes: Mobile autoplay policies may require starting audio muted and only enabling sound after an explicit user gesture; design player behavior accordingly.
known_issues: Build/deploy failing due to internal configuration error; may require platform (Caffeine) team intervention.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Watercolor-style couple illustration with pink floral background and title text (hero-bg.dim_736x964.png)

existing_features.title: Add the user-uploaded image (1770099054248.png) as the default Hero section background so it displays immediately when no hero background has been uploaded via the Media Manager.

Update the background music player to satisfy the HARD RULES: background audio autoplays silently on page load, loops continuously, uses a user-provided MP3 uploaded via the Media Manager, shows only a small bottom-right player popup with play/pause control, and keeps a lightly visible audio tag on-screen; remove any UI that implies required user interaction (e.g., “tap to start” prompts).

Ensure the Image Memory section renders a responsive grid of 43 image cards driven by the existing slot configuration, with each card clickable/tappable to perform a smooth 3D rotate/flip and fade-in romantic message reveal on the back; keep soft shadow and rounded corners.

In “working mode” (Media Manager), provide clear, mobile-friendly per-image-slot controls to add/replace images, open the drag/zoom adjust UI, reorder (drag where supported), and save/submit changes so updates appear in the Image Memory grid after submitting/publishing.

Ensure the Video Memory section renders a grid of 6 videos with preserved aspect ratio, supports adding/replacing videos via the Media Manager before publishing, and keeps the existing mobile-friendly playback configuration (playsInline, looping, default-muted).
Add the newly bundled hero background image to the frontend assets and reference it consistently from the Hero section (and/or media store defaulting logic) without routing it through the backend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Set provided image as the hero section background.

Background music player: autoplay silently on page load, loop continuously, uses a custom MP3, includes play/pause controls in the bottom-right, lightweight visible audio tag, mobile autoplay compatible, no user interaction required.

Image Memory section: responsive grid of 43+ image cards (support unlimited images), add images before publishing, each card clickable/tappable with smooth 3D rotate + fade to reveal a romantic message on the back; soft shadow and rounded corners; working mode includes add/replace, drag-to-adjust, and save controls.
Video Memory section: grid of 6 videos with preserved aspect ratio; allow adding videos before publishing.
